## Activity

During July 2026, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 362 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. Activity should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that any changes in workload or operational performance can be identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 362 captures, 24 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.6. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and help maintain the quality of images submitted for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 98 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This measure should continue to be reviewed alongside capture activity and image quality results, as timely grading supports the onward management of referable findings.
